story.iWant: to configure strategy parameters such as chunk amounts, payment frequencies, and target account overrides
story.soThat: I can customize the debt acceleration calculations to my specific situation and preferences, rather than relying solely on default values

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: User can configure a custom chunk amount for flexi strategies (default: full available surplus)
User can configure payment frequency for strategies (Monthly, Bi-Weekly, Weekly)
User can configure a target account override to manually select which debt to prioritize
Configuration is stored in the Dexie settings table as JSON with key strategyConfig
Default configuration is created on first access if none exists
When configuration changes, strategies recalculate using the new parameters
The existing StrategyConfig interface in types.ts is extended to include new configuration options
A useStrategyConfig hook provides React components access to read and update configuration
A StrategyConfig UI component allows users to modify configuration via a form with validation
Unit tests verify configuration loading, saving, and application to strategy calculations
All strategies (8 total) respect the configuration when calculating projections

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: User can configure strategy parameters (chunk amounts, payment frequencies, target accounts)

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Settings table uses key-value store with string key as primary key. Values stored as JSON strings for complex data.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Use big.js for all monetary calculations including chunk amounts to ensure cent-level precision.

doc.snippet: AC1: User can configure chunk amount. AC2: Payment frequency (monthly, bi-weekly, weekly). AC3: Target account override. AC4: Configuration persists in Dexie settings table.

doc.title: Epic 4 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: StrategyConfig contains chunkAmount (optional string), paymentFrequency ('monthly'|'bi-weekly'|'weekly'), targetAccountId (optional number).

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Use shadcn/ui Form, Input, Select components. React Hook Form + Zod for validation. Toast notifications for feedback. Currency inputs use ZAR formatting with R prefix.

constraints.constraint: All monetary values stored as strings for big.js precision (ADR-003)
Use Result type for error handling in hooks: Result<T, E> = { success: true; data: T } | { success: false; error: E }
Hooks use useLiveQuery for reactive database queries
Form components use React Hook Form + Zod validation
Toast notifications via sonner for user feedback
Calculation logic in src/lib/calculations/ is framework-agnostic
Files: kebab-case, Components: PascalCase, Hooks: use prefix, Functions: camelCase
Unit tests in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure
Existing StrategyConfig properties (maxMonths, startDate, extraPayment) must remain intact
Default config: chunkAmount=null (use full surplus), paymentFrequency='monthly', targetAccountId=null (use strategy default)

tests.standards: Tests use Vitest framework with describe/it/expect pattern. Test files co-located in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Use fake-indexeddb for Dexie database mocking. React components tested with @testing-library/react. Acceptance criteria referenced in describe blocks (e.g., "AC-4.7.1: ..."). Test coverage targets: 90% for calculation functions, 80% for hooks.
